items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cootie Williams, he was a very strong trumpet player and he played way over here on the side of his mouth. Cootie Williams, well, he was something else and Duke Ellington‘s band, man, Cootie was, man.

items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Plunger man. And then Cootie came in and took that away from him... Cootie played way over on the side of his mouth when he played, but he could play, man.

ctx.x: Plunger man. And then Cootie came in and took that away from him, because Cootie come in and play that plunger thing, man, he was something else. Cootie played way over on the side of his mouth when he played, but he could play, man.
